Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The India Women players are out there in the middle. Nannapat Koncharoenkai and Natthakan Chantham are the openers for Thailand Women. Deepti Sharma to start with the ball. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, Thailand Women have done well to keep India under check here. They are still in this game but can they do the job with the bat? A place in the final is up for the grabs. Stay tuned for the run-chase!

Jemimah Rodrigues comes up for a quick chat. Says that it's a good feeling to be in form. Tells that this Asia Cup has been good, especially after returning from injury. She wants to extend her form and score as many runs as possible. Mentions that the competition has been excellent in this tournament and praises Thailand Women for their bowling. Tells that they want to build on their confidence and become the best team in the world.

The Thailand bowlers bowled pretty well right from the start, however, some poor catching did not help their cause. They though managed to keep things tight throughout with Tippoch being the pick of the bowlers with three wickets. All others also bowled quite well and they were spectacular, especially at the death.

Tha dangerous Indian Women openers got them off to a decent start but Thailand managed to get rid of Smriti Mandhana inside the Powerplay. Shafali Verma was given a couple of chances and she made them pay with an aggressive knock of 42. After she departed, the partnership flourished between Jemimah Rodrigues and Kaur but India never managed to get into the top gear as both of them departed after getting starts. India could manage only two maximums in their innings and that sums up their overall performance with the bat here.

India have got 148 on the board and have to say, Thailand bowlers have done pretty well to keep themselves in this game as India managed only 31 runs in the last five overs and lost 3 wickets. Things could have been better for them had they taken those catches on the field but it still is a good effort against a powerful Indian batting line-up. India would be a tad disappointed with their batting performance but they surely have all the arsenal to defend this total.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket on the final ball. Loopy and around off, fuller in length, Deepti Sharma shimmies down the track and attempts to clear long on but fails to get the desired distance behind her shot. Rosenan Kanoh settles underneath it near the fence and judges the skier to perfection. India Women finish on 148 for 6.
Commentary.Howout: c Rosenan Kanoh b Nattaya Boochatham

Commentary.Commentary: Put down but it was a tough chance. Around off, Pooja smashes it back aerially and the ball hits the bowler's hand on the full. It deflects to long on and they cross.
Flatter again, on middle, it's forced past the bowler to long on. The fielder there misses but the long on fielder does well to cut it off. Another two.
Full around middle, Pooja is down the track as she swings it towards wide long on for two.
Full and flighted on off, Sharma walks forward and lofts it over mid off for a single.
Short and outside off, Sharma punches it from the back foot but finds the cover fielder.
SIX! India Women break the shackles. Flatter delivery, around off, Pooja wears her skates and powers it over long on for a maximum.
Jumps down the track and chips a full ball over wide mid on for a run.
Lands it full and on middle, Pooja uses her feet and lofts it down to long on for just a run.
Puts it on a fuller length around off, Sharma flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and on middle, Pooja wrists it towards mid on for a single.
Floated and on middle, it's driven back to the bowler.
Deepti Sharma walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! No mistake this time from Thailand Women and it's a big setback for India Women at this stage of the innings. Tossed up around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur sits down to power it across the line but only manages to drag it aerially towards wide long on. Natthakan Chantham is stationed there and she judges the catch to perfection.
Commentary.Howout: c Natthakan Chantham b Sornnarin Tippoch

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! The catching has been quite poor from the Thai team. Loopy delivery, a full toss around leg, Kaur gets down the track and slogs it aerially over square leg. The fielder in the deep drops a dolly and the batters collect two.
Fuller and flatter on middle, forced down to long on for another run in this over. Thailand doing well to not concede a boundary ball.
Loopy around off, Kaur skips down the track to take it on the full and drives it to deep cover for one.
Pooja Vastrakar also uses her feet and whips a full ball to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Harmanpreet Kaur jumps down the track and drags it to long on for a run.
Sornnarin Tippoch continues. This is her last over.
Loopy and full, around off, Kaur slogs it to deep mid-wicket and retains strike with a single.
Quicker and fuller, on off, Kaur drags her attempted drive to mid on.
Flighted on off, Pooja walks forward and strokes it to long off for a single.
Gets forward and forces a full ball down to long off for one.
Fullish around off, Pooja flicks it wide of mid on and takes a single.
A half-tracker on off, Kaur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated and full, around off, it's flicked to short mid-wicket.
Wide! Skidding down the leg side, Pooja Vastrakar tries to flick but misses. The keeper fumbles and Pooja looks for a run but Kaur sends her back.
Short in length and outside off, cut to point.
Pooja Vastrakar walks out to the middle now.

OUT! Trapped in front! Sornnarin Tippoch gives this one some extra flight time and lands it on a fuller length around off. Richa Ghosh goes down to sweep but misses and is hit on the back thigh. They appeal and the umpire has no hesitation in raising the finger.

Stumping appeal is turned down! Ghosh gives a predetermined charge to the bowler but is beaten in flight. She immediately plants her foot inside the crease as the keeper breaks the stumps. Richa uses her hand to regain balance as she was about to fall.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Misfield. Flatter and shorter on off, Richa Ghosh punches it towards point where the fielder dives but fails to stop it. They get two runs.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Ghosh tries to flick but misses.
Sornnarin Tippoch will be eyeing a breakthrough in this over.

FOUR! Another boundary to end the over! So a good over has been spoiled by two boundaries off the last two deliveries. Shortish length and outside off. Kaur cuts and gets it through the gap towards the backward point fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur finally finds the gap and a boundary. Touch shorter and outside off. Kaur uses the depth of the crease quite well this time and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Four dots in a row now! She bowls it quicker and shorter outside off. Kaur goes back and tries to cut it but misses.
Excellent bowling. This is angled into middle and Kaur only manages to clip it towards the leg side.
Another dot! Quicker and fuller, around off. Kaur tries to drive but gets no timing.
Kaur goes back and punches this flatter delivery on off back to the bowler.
Nattaya Boochatham (2-0-17-0) is back into the attack.
A fullish and quicker delivery on off. Ghosh drives it back to the bowler.
Richa Ghosh walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jemimah Rodrigues holes out in the deep and Thailand Women get their third wicket! Nicely bowled, it is tossed up on middle, inviting Jemimah Rodrigues to go over the top and she tries to do exactly that. However, the ball goes off the bottom part of her blade and aerially towards long on. Rosenan Kanoh there settles under it and takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Rosenan Kanoh b Thipatcha Putthawong

Commentary.Commentary: This time it is through that gap! Fullish delivery on off. Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and drives it to the right of the point fielder for a couple.
Just short of the fielder! Goes fuller and on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and slices her drive aerially just short of the point fielder.
Touch shorter and on middle. Kaur goes back and clips it to deep square leg for a single.
A fuller one on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it down to long on for a single.
Change. Thipatcha Putthawong comes back into the attack.
Tossed up on middle. Kaur defends it gently. 8 from this over, 32 from the last three.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A full toss on leg. Kaur waits for it and places it in the gap towards the backward square leg region for a boundary.

In the air but well short of the fielder. Floated up on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues goes for the sweep shot. However, she gets a top edge that falls short of the deep mid-wicket fielder and a single is taken.
Slower through the air on middle. Kaur clips it to mid-wicket for a single. 100 up!
A flatter one on off. Kaur pushes it to covers.
On leg and fuller. Kaur paddles it towards the fine leg region for a couple.
FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues is turning it on now! Full delivery on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues slog-sweeps it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fires it around leg. Kaur tries to paddle it and gets just a fine tickle on it. The ball goes off the keeper's pad towards the off side for a single.

Floated up on off. Jemimah Rodrigues skips down the track and plays an inside-out drive through the cover region. The ball though does not travel to the fence and it is just a single as the fielder cuts it off.
Fullish delivery on middle. Kaur drives it right of the bowler. She moves to her right and tries to stop it with a dive but only half-stops it. A single taken.
This is around off. Jemimah Rodrigues gets across to her right and paddles it to fine leg for a single.
Slower through the air on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues works it towards the leg side.
Touch shorter and on middle. Kaur goes back and punches it to covers. 16 from the over!
Angled into middle. Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! All class from this talented Indian number 3! Tossed up on off. Jemimah Rodrigues makes a bit of room and plays a delightful inside-out drive over extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! This time Jemimah Rodrigues with a quality shot! Fuller delivery on off. Jemimah Rodrigues kneels and sweeps it firmly through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Misfield! A fuller one on off. Kaur drives it to mid off. The fielder there fumbles and a single is taken.
FOUR! Power from Kaur! This one is tossed up on middle. Kaur skips down the track and slams it down the ground for a boundary.

NO BALL! Shorter in length on off. Jemimah Rodrigues rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. There was one extra fielder outside the ring and it is called a no ball. Free Hit coming up.
Nanthita Boonsukham is into the attack now.
Nanthita Boonsukham is introduced into the attack.
Flatter and shorter around off, Kaur punches it from the back foot, towards the bowler. At the halfway mark, India Women are 73 for 2.
A predetermined paddle sweep again from Harmanpreet Kaur. She adjusts to the slowness of the delivery and eases it towards fine leg for a brace.
Another paddle shot from Kaur but this time more from the top half of her bat. Full and around off, Kaur sends it down to fine leg for another couple.
Very full and on middle, Kaur defends it back to the bowler.
Floated and full, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur paddles it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.

Drinks break. Thailand Women have done well so far to take two dangerous India Women openers out of their way. They bowled well at the start but missed some golden chances to put India on the mat early. India now have a good platform to launch from here. They have a strong batting line-up and Thai girls need to keep taking wickets at regular intervals to keep India under check. The Indian skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The ploy to have a short mid-wicket works for Thailand Women. Sornnarin Tippoch has indeed broken the partnership. Flighted delivery, around middle, Shafali Verma goes hard at it as she tries to whip it across the line. The ball takes the bottom part of her bat and flies straight into the hands of Naruemol Chaiwai. The Thai skipper makes no mistake and they are all smiles. A massive breakthrough for them as Shafali Verma was looking dangerous.
Commentary.Howout: c Naruemol Chaiwai b Sornnarin Tippoch

Commentary.Commentary: Sornnarin Tippoch is into the attack now. Can she break this partnership?
Loopy and full, outside off, Jemimah shuffles across and paddles it towards short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller and on off, this time Verma sweeps and sends it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flicks a full ball on the leg side but finds the short mid-wicket fielder.
Good stop in the deep! Tossed up, full and around off, Verma sweeps it through square leg. The fielder in deep dives and stops the racing ball. Saves two.
Fuller and on off, Jemimah jumps down the track and knocks it to long on for one.
Skidding down the leg side, it's helped down behind square leg for a single.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues works it gently to the right of the mid-wicket fielder and looks for a run. Shafali Verma is not interested.
Quicker and fuller, around off, Shafali Verma hits it across the line to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues swats it down to long off for a run.
Use of the feet from Shafali Verma and she eases a full ball down to long on for a single.
Arm ball, short and on off, Verma goes back and punches but finds the cover fielder.
SIX! Put away! Flighted delivery, full and around middle, Shafali Verma skips down the track and hammers it over wide long on for a maximum - the first of the semi-final.
Flighted and full, around off, Shafali Verma walks across the stumps and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single. A tidy first over from Onnicha Kamchomphu.
Fullish around off, Rodrigues sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Extra bounce and turn. Around off, Jemimah Rodrigues attempts to defend but misses and it goes off her front pad to the off side.
Walks forward and works a full ball through mid-wicket for a single.
This one goes through everyone. Loopy and full, outside off, Jemimah tries to sweep but there is some extra bounce and it goes over her bat and the keeper. They cross for a bye.
A low full toss on middle, it's driven back to the bowler.
Onnicha Kamchomphu is into the attack now.
Quicker and flatter arm ball, around off, Verma goes on the back foot and keeps it out. At the end of the Powerplay, India Women are 47 for 1.
Flighted on off, Shafali Verma advances down the track to take it on the full but drives it from the bottom half to covers.

Top edge but safe! Loopy and full, around off, Jemimah Rodrigues goes down to slog-sweep but it takes the top edge. The ball lands safely in front of the onrushing deep mid-wicket fielder. They take one.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it to mid off. Another dot.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it back towards short mid-wicket.
Flighted and full, around leg, Jemimah Rodrigues tries to flick but misses and it goes off her pads to square leg.
Thipatcha Putthawong comes into the attack.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Maya bowls it short and on off. Shafali Verma picks the length quickly and slaps it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
This is bowled on a fuller length and way outside off. Verma leaves it.
A fullish delivery, on off. Verma tries to go over cover but ends up slicing it over short third man. The batters make sure that they get two runs here.
A length delivery, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to deep point for a single.
Jemimah Rodrigues, in sublime form, walks in next at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh, Smriti Mandhana departs playing a full toss and Thailand Women finally get a breakthrough! This is a friendly full toss, around off. Smriti Mandhana tries to power it over mid on. However, she does not get any timing on this one and the ball goes off the bottom half of her blade towards mid on. Onnicha Kamchomphu takes an easy catch there and this is a big wicket for Thailand Women, as the dangerous Smriti Mandhana walks back disappointed.
Commentary.Howout: c Onnicha Kamchomphu b Phannita Maya

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Poor line and punished! This is on a length again on leg. Smriti Mandhana walks down the pitch and clips it aerially towards the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Lands on a length, on middle. Smriti Mandhana clips it towards the leg side.
Phannita Maya is the first bowling change. One slip in place and the keeper is standing up to the stumps.
FOUR! Smashed! Fuller in length and around off, Shafali Verma gets close to the line and whips it wide of mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! Fullish delivery on middle. Swinging in and Shafali Verma just chips it over mid on for a boundary.
In the air...but safe! A fullish delivery, on off. Smriti Mandhana tries to go over the top but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air but over the cover fielder for a single.
On a length, on off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out.

Another chance goes begging! Shafali Verma survives again. A fullish delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana creams it to cover-point. The fielder there stops it but there is a bit of a fumble and Verma comes almost halfway down the pitch looking for a run but Smriti sends her back. The throw at the bowler's end is quite weak and Shafali Verma gets back to her crease.
On a length and outside off, Verma walks down the pitch and powers it away to deep point for a single.
Dot to end the over but an expensive one. This is angled into middle and Smriti Mandhana blocks it out. 13 from the over!
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana with an elegant shot now. A tad shorter and around off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and punches it through extra cover for a boundary.
Pushed quicker and outside off. Verma dabs it behind square on the off side for a single.

Dropped! Thai girls need to take their catches. This is a tad shorter in length and on off. Shafali Verma punches it uppishly towards covers. The fielder there drops a sitter and Verma gets a big life.
FOUR! Shafali Verma is on the attack now! Fuller delivery on off. Verma stays in her crease and lifts it straight down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Shafali Verma starts the over with a boundary! This is a flatter delivery on middle. Verma gets a bit across and sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Dot to end the over! Lands on a length, on off. Smriti Mandhana tries to push it away but again gets no timing on this one.
Bowls a bit fuller and on off. Smriti Mandhana drives but again without much timing to mid off.
On a length and outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it gently towards the off side.
WIDE! Errs in line and bowls this down the leg side. Smriti Mandhana tries to clip it but misses.
FOUR! First boundary of this semifinal! It is a bit short on off. Smriti Mandhana is too good a player to miss out on this one and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

Beaten all ends up! Serves it on a good length and outside off. There is a good shape away from the batter and Smriti Mandhana tries to drive it away. She misses and the keeper collects the ball and fires a direct under-arm throw at the batter's end. Smriti Mandhana though is well in.
On a good length and outside off. Smriti Mandhana dabs it towards the point fielder.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's Chanida Sutthiruang.
Tad shorter and turning into middle, Shafali Verma rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple. Good first over from Nattaya Boochatham!
Pushed a bit quicker on off. Verma defends it onto the pitch.

Leading edge this time! Slower through the air again, on off. Verma tries to clip it towards the leg side. However, she gets the leading edge that goes over the cover fielder and the batters take two.
A flatter one on off. Verma fails to connect again as the ball hits her pads.

Oh, this one misses everything! This one is tossed up, outside off. Shafali Verma gets across and tries to play it towards the leg side. However, the ball does not turn and misses the outside edge of her blade. The keeper misses it too and the batters run two byes as the slip fielder cuts it off.
Starts off by bowling slower through the air, on off. Shafali Verma works it towards the leg side.
It's time to get underway! Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the openers for India Women. It's going to be Nattaya Boochatham to bowl the first over. Here we go...

Natthakan Chantham comes up for a quick chat. She says that they are happy to be in the semi-final and they are excited. Shares that she was sleeping when someone told her about them getting to the semis. Mentions that this is the second chance for Thailand to play some good cricket. Tells that the Indian team advised them to be brave and do the basics right after the last game.

Pitch Report - Athar Ali Khan is down for the pitch report. Says that the pitch has been very good and the batters have enjoyed this pitch. Tells that it looks a bit dry and there are a couple of patches of concern which are darker and there is a bit of roughness. Adds that the bowlers will try to cash in on these spots but overall he feels that it is a very good pitch for batting. Mentions that the team winning the toss would like to bat first.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says that it is a big game for all of them and they are happy to get the game with the sun out. Tells that they are looking to improve and they have been playing well. Tells that they are happy with the development of the team and informs that it has been difficult to select the playing XI and informs that Meghna Singh, Sabbhineni Meghana and Kiran Navgire miss out.

Naruemol Chaiwai, the captain of Thailand Women, says that they want to bowl first due to the weather conditions and she feels that the ball might move around. Wants to restrict the Indian team. Mentions that they are very excited about this game. Admits that India Women are better than them but they will give it their all. Informs that Thailand Women are unchanged.

Thailand Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Nannapat Koncharoenkai (WK), Natthakan Chantham, Naruemol Chaiwai (C), Chanida Sutthiruang, Rosenan Kanoh, Phannita Maya, Sornnarin Tippoch, Nattaya Boochatham, Onnicha Kamchomphu, Thipatcha Putthawong, Nanthita Boonsukham.

India Women (Playing XI) -  Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C) (In place of Sabbhineni Meghana), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Renuka Singh (In place of Meghna Singh), Pooja Vastrakar, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Radha Yadav (In place of Kiran Navgire).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Thailand Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

It has been a roller-coaster ride for the girls from Thailand. They have played some fantastic cricket, even beating Pakistan on the way, but were handed a reality check by India in their last league game. Indian spinners were too hot to handle for the Thailand girls and it is now time for them to display their character and skills on the big stage. A good performance here can surely go a long way in boosting their confidence, can they deliver a spirited performance? Or will India Women continue their dominance? Stay tuned for the toss and further updates.
